It's the weekend once again, with ongoing 25% discounts on AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off AirPods Max 2, but today's top story on 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to stock at $1,099 in three colors via Apple's official refurbished store (a $200 savings)—this configuration tends to sell out fast, so act quickly. We also have MacBook Neo with up to $120 off new pricing, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop bands at nearly $100 off on Amazon, plus the latest 240W Beats Woven USB-C cable making its Amazon debut at an all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off). Keep an eye on updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School promotions while stock lasts—scroll down for more details.

Most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to stock at $1,099 in three colors via Apple's official refurbished store ($200 off)

Apple's official refurbished store has long been a great way to save money, especially as MacBook pricing has crept up at retail. Stock of the entry-level configurations in both the Pro and M5 MacBook Air lines has been turning over quickly—this morning we spotted the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air back in stock across all three colors, starting at just $1,099, which is $200 below MSRP.

Apple's official Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099 with shipping included. As of writing, the deal is still live and includes the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These machines come with the following coverage:

  • Apple 1-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

What you're looking at here is the most affordable M5 MacBook Air configuration, with a new unit MSRP of $1,299. Today's refurbished deal at $1,099 is $200 below the new sticker price—it's the best price we can find on the current entry-level model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (regularly $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is the Apple refurbished store, so it's arguably one of the highest-quality refurbished MacBook Airs out there, but how does it compare to current retail pricing on a new unit?

Amazon has largely held firm on pricing for this configuration, with the Silver model going for slightly less at $1,240. While this machine has sold for less in the past, we haven't seen it dip below $1,149 brand new on Amazon since the price hike—and even that was a fleeting deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop bands now nearly $100 off on Amazon

If you ask me, the two best-looking smartwatch pairings in the world are now nearly $100 off on Amazon—the Natural Titanium or Black versions of the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with a Milanese Loop band.

While the $100 discount on the more affordable Ocean Band configuration is gone, Amazon is now selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop band for $799.99 with shipping included.

These two configurations carry a premium price tag of $899 thanks to their gorgeous woven steel Milanese bands, but Amazon is now offering nearly $100 off:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop band $800 (regularly $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop band $800 (regularly $899)

Apple is expected to launch a new generation of Ultra wearables next month, but with 'RAMageddon' having already spread across the iPad and MacBook lines, new Apple Watch models could very well be the next victim. The current lineup hasn't been affected yet, but since these are essentially tiny computers on your wrist, the Ultra 4 / Series 12 could be next in line to take the hit.

Of course, we wouldn't blame anyone for waiting to see what else Apple has in store for September, but with less than a month to go, these products could very well cost more than they do now.

The Series models face a similar situation, and they're also seeing $100 discounts on Amazon right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regularly $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regularly $429)

Grab the latest 240W Beats Woven USB-C cable at an Amazon all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

While the 10-foot Beats Woven USB-C cable is still in stock, grab this 240W black model now at an all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping.

Amazon is now selling the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C Woven Cable for $18.03, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 models offer improved power delivery with an MSRP of $30, which frankly feels a bit steep even for a high-quality 10-foot USB-C cable. But at a 40% discount off MSRP, I think every daily carry or home setup should have a few of these premium, great-looking models.

Today's headline low price is on the Bolt Black model, but you can also find Navy at $19, Surge Stone down to $20.85 after on-page coupon, and the red model for nearly $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to a solid 240W power delivery, plus the extended 10-foot length with the same tangle-resistant woven design—"more durable, more convenient. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, kinks, and frays with our reinforced woven cable."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular models at $100 off, deals from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charger drops back to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

When it launched earlier this year, I had the chance to test it out, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime Foldable MagSafe Charger has since become a staple in my daily carry, luggage, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we're looking at the lowest price we've seen on Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon store is now selling its latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime Foldable MagSafe Charger for $99.97 with shipping included.

This unit carries an MSRP of $150 and features a 3-in-1 configuration with the MagSafe pad delivering up to 25W output. It's now available at nearly 35% off in Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colorways.

This week's deal matches what we've seen before, equaling Anker's Summer Sale discount and this year's Prime Day pricing.

While this unit is palm-sized and portable, it still has enough heft to sit steadily on your desk or nightstand—equally at home on a work desk at the house or out and about.

Official Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo priced lowest, up to $120 below MSRP

Beyond the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's more affordable new MacBook Neo also saw a price bump recently, but you can sidestep that hike through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store—the MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but you can grab one from Apple's best refurbished store with full Apple warranty starting from $599.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers the complete MacBook Neo lineup across all configurations at the lowest prices we can find from a reputable source, and it comes with genuine Apple warranty and Apple's 'rigorous' refurbishment certification.

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (regularly $699 new)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (regularly $799 new)

While opening the Apple Refurbished Store product page doesn't seem to reveal any special deals, every model is actually at least $100 below the new MSRP—the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is effectively $120 below the new pricing, which is another $20 below its previous pricing.

Sure, they're refurbished units, and they're just bringing the price back to roughly the old MSRP, but we're talking about the lowest prices available on the most affordable current-generation MacBook right now.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 might not be worth going the refurbished route, and that's understandable—but that's certainly not a small amount, and we're talking about the highest-quality refurbished units straight from Apple.
